scope: Source mechanism for the measured C1 regression; no per-stage timing attribution.

facts.fact: For sparseBlockSize=1 and a visible token, blockLen=1 and copyRowCnt=1. Moving to the next token reads topKGm and calculates its new interval.
RoPE64 uses the 576-wide path with two 288-wide K passes. The separate NoRope path is not active for this experiment.

The C-template while loop calls CalcTopKBlockInfo and DataCopyPA for K and RoPE, then advances copyFinishRowCnt by copyRowCnt. At C1 this is one token per iteration, revisited across the two K passes.
Every such row reads the block table, computes the selected physical GM address and issues ND2NZ through DataCopyGmNDToL1.
nValue=rowAct, so the C1 operation above submits a one-row copy.
The V-input copy repeats the same one-token walker for each output-column tile.
The packed V-template source is contiguous. It issues ND2NZ with nValue=nL1Size, which is 128 for the full tiles in this fixture.
The packed V-template path issues ND2NZ with nValue=kL0Size, 128 for these full tiles.

conclusion: C1 exposes a serial chain of selected-index reads, page-table reads and one-row copies inside both matrix multiplications. The paired timing measures the whole V1-to-C1 route change; it does not price this loop separately.
